findings.claim: spec-6 section 5 (Schema gate rule + fixtures) requires two fail fixtures for ACDSL-JSON-003 — one with "mode": "loose" and one with an unknown key — but only one fail file exists and it carries both defects (mode "loose" on line 2, unknown key editable_rules on line 3). Deleting "additionalProperties": false from acdsl/policy.schema.json leaves the fail set red (mode still violates the enum), so the unknown-key rejection the schema promises is pinned by nothing.
findings.evidence: Re-read acdsl/testdata/ACDSL-JSON-003/fail/policy.json (one file, both defects), acdsl/policy.schema.json:4 (additionalProperties false) and :7 (mode enum), spec-6-raw.md:363 ("fail/ one with mode loose and one with an unknown key"). internal/acdsl/fixtures.go:95 judges a fail set as a whole ("fail fixture not flagged" only when the set yields zero diagnostics), so any one remaining violation keeps it green-as-expected. git ls-files shows only fail/policy.json and pass/policy.json under ACDSL-JSON-003.
findings.fix: Add the spec's unknown-key-only fail fixture and change fail/policy.json to the mode-only defect; since the fail set is judged as a whole, also pin additionalProperties with a Go test validating {"mode":"gated","editable_rules":[]} against acdsl/policy.schema.json.

findings.claim: runCheck's new policy wiring (LoadPolicy/CheckPolicy at 122-131 and the merge of policyDiagnostics into the printed set and exit code at 137) has no test: cmd/acdsl has no test files and cmd/tests/test_acdsl.sh only runs acdsl check on the real tree, whose policy.json is mode free. Deleting line 137 keeps every suite green while acdsl check in a gated target (dist ships dist_mode gated) would print OK and exit 0 for a branch that adds a protected rule.
findings.evidence: Re-read cmd/acdsl/main.go:122-151 — policy diagnostics reach output and exitViolations only through the append at 137. go test ./cmd/acdsl/... reports [no test files]; grep for CheckPolicy/policy.json/ACDSL-POLICY over cmd and internal finds only main.go, the hook script, dist.go and the internal/acdsl tests; test_acdsl.sh check invocations (lines 42, 80, 93, 121, 190, 239, 254-282) never set up a gated/strict policy. acdsl/policy.json mode is free, so the real-tree check never emits policy diagnostics. spec-6 Tests table names no runCheck case and its Not-tested line lists only settings registration and README prose.
findings.fix: Add a test_acdsl.sh scenario: temp git repo with a committed gated policy and registry, a work branch adding an ACDSL-PLAN-* rule, assert acdsl check exits 1 and prints a [ACDSL-POLICY] line.

findings.claim: ruleDelta's deleted-declaration-file path (work-side read fails at 248, base side read at 251-257, rules then classified removed at 274-278) is never exercised: every CheckPolicy/ruleDelta test rewrites acdsl/rules.acdsl in place or adds a file. rules.acdsl is not in policySurface, so ruleDelta is the only guard against a gated/strict branch that git-rms the declaration file; a regression that skips a path whose working copy is missing (e.g. continue on readErr) drops every protected removal and the suite stays green.
findings.evidence: Re-read internal/acdsl/policy.go:237-280 and policySurface at 31-36 (no rules.acdsl). Re-read policy_test.go: TestCheckPolicyGatedScopes (204), TestCheckPolicyGatedChangedMarkerLine (219), TestCheckPolicyStrictFlagsRuleAndSurface (172), TestRuleDelta (312-313) all writePolicyFile the declaration file; none removes it.
